dialogues.speaker: Daniil
dialogues.text: Train delays should never be ignored. A similar incident occurred 500 years ago, and it was later revealed to be connected to a conspiracy involving Snezhnograd and Kresnik's Torch!

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: You've heard of that as well? I didn't expect someone your age to be so well-versed in history. To be honest, I find this whole situation a little suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: I've already noticed a few things. There are a lot more staff on the platform today than usual. And this is just about the season when the snow and ice start to thaw, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Daniil
dialogues.text: Indeed. The conspiracy from five hundred years ago began in much the same season.

dialogues.speaker: Arseny
dialogues.text: Come on, aren't you all reading a little too much into this? The train is only ten minutes late...

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: Arseny, do you have to shoot me down every single time? Look at this gentleman, he's clearly well-traveled and well-informed. Unlike you, he doesn't start making a fuss the moment something happens.

dialogues.speaker: Daniil
dialogues.text: Haha, you flatter me. A delayed train, an uncertain situation, I'd say it's only natural that Mr. Arseny would be a bit tense.

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: Exactly. Think about it. If it were just a normal delay, someone from the train staff would have told us what was going on by now.

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: But no one's said a word. That means something serious must have happened, and the Transport Bureau doesn't want to scare the passengers...

dialogues.speaker: Arseny
dialogues.text: Come on, i-it can't be that bad... right?

dialogues.speaker: Daniil
dialogues.text: Mr. Arseny, you need to face the facts. History has taught us plenty of lessons already. Things like this have happened before on the snowfields, and we'd be foolish not to learn from them.

dialogues.speaker: Veronika
dialogues.text: And haven't there been rumors lately... about people working against Snezhnograd?

dialogues.speaker: Arseny
dialogues.text: That's enough... please. Let's just go home.
